messages.author: f4b3d79e3ad1004b
messages.subject: N-Mixture Modelling Course
parts:
Hello all, 
I'm wondering if anyone is aware of any courses that include n-mixture modelling being offered in 2023? 
I've reviewed most of the tutorials, vignettes, etc, but I would benefit most from being able to ask questions to an instructor. If none are available, I would be open to suggestions for tutors. 

Many thanks!
Mike

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] N-Mixture Modelling Course
parts:
Hi Mike,

Andy Royle, Ken Kellner and I had talked about teaching a 5-day workshop at Patuxent in Laurel MD this summer. Topics would be taken mostly from the AHM books mo, thus including Nmix models. This is not sure yet, however, but we plan to decide soon and then advertise on this list.

Best regards  --- Marc

To: unmarked <unma...@googlegroups.com>
Subject: [unmarked] N-Mixture Modelling Course

Hello all, 
I'm wondering if anyone is aware of any courses that include n-mixture modelling being offered in 2023? 
I've reviewed most of the tutorials, vignettes, etc, but I would benefit most from being able to ask questions to an instructor. If none are available, I would be open to suggestions for tutors. 

Many thanks!
Mike

--
*** Three hierarchical modeling email lists ***
(1) unmarked (this list): for questions specific to the R package unmarked
(2) SCR: for design and Bayesian or non-bayesian analysis of spatial capture-recapture
(3) HMecology: for everything else, especially material covered in the books by Royle & Dorazio (2008), Kéry & Schaub (2012), Kéry & Royle (2016, 2021) and Schaub & Kéry (2022)
